uncited: *   **Inputs**: A 3D scalar volume field $V$, a piecewise-linear transfer function $T(f)$ mapping scalar values to color and opacity $\rho_\alpha$, camera parameters (origin, direction, near/far planes), and an isovalue $\tau$ (or a set of isovalue peaks derived from $T$).
Each entry corresponds to a segment defined by entry field value $f_i$ and exit field value $f_o$.
Analyze the transfer function $T(f)$ to identify local maxima (peaks) in the opacity component $\rho_\alpha$.
*   If $i < j$: Search for peaks where $\rho_\alpha(\upsilon) > i$ and $\rho_\alpha(\upsilon) \le j$.
*   If $i > j$: Search in descending order for peaks where $\rho_\alpha(\upsilon) \le i$ and $\rho_\alpha(\upsilon) > j$.
*   Computes the color and opacity contribution at the given position.
*   **History**: It was developed to address the limitations of postclassification and preintegration in rendering sharp transfer function features.
